description_en: Queries administrator operation audit logs in batches
description_zh: 批量查询管理员操作审计日志
name: ListOperationAuditLogs

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be earlier than EndTime. The interval between StartTime and EndTime cannot exceed 30 days, and StartTime cannot be more than 31 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始时间，秒级Unix时间戳。取值必须小于EndTime，与EndTime的间隔不超过30天，且距当前时间不超过31天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be later than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，秒级Unix时间戳。取值必须大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。起始值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source type of the event. Valid values:
console: The event is triggered by a console call.
sdk: The event is triggered by an SDK call
parameters.help_zh:
事件来源类型。取值：
console：控制台调用。
sdk：SDK调用
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID (AliUid) of the operator
parameters.name: operator_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation feature module. The value must be the English code of the feature module. If you specify other values, no records are queried. Valid values:
PrivateAccess: internal network access
OfficeNetworkAccess: office network access
AppAcceleration: application acceleration
InternetAccess: Internet access
OfficeDataProtection: office data protection
IdentityAccessManagement: identity and access management
DeviceManagement: endpoint management
ApprovalCenter: approval center
SoftwareManagement: software management
LogAnalysis: log analysis
Setting: settings
DigitalWatermark: digital watermarking
DynamicDecision: dynamic decision-making
InternetBehaviorManagement: Internet behavior management
AgentOfficeSecurity: agent office security
NetworkAccess: network access
RiskManagement: risk management
EndpointProtection: endpoint protection
Overview: overview page
ITManagement: IT management
InstanceManagement: instance management
parameters.help_zh:
操作功能模块。取值为功能模块的英文编码，传入其他值将查询不到任何记录。取值：
PrivateAccess：内网访问。
OfficeNetworkAccess：办公网准入。
AppAcceleration：应用加速。
InternetAccess：互联网访问。
OfficeDataProtection：办公数据保护。
IdentityAccessManagement：身份认证管理。
DeviceManagement：终端管理。
ApprovalCenter：审批中心。
SoftwareManagement：软件管理。
LogAnalysis：日志分析。
Setting：设置。
DigitalWatermark：数字水印。
DynamicDecision：动态决策。
InternetBehaviorManagement：上网行为管理。
AgentOfficeSecurity：Agent办公安全。
NetworkAccess：网络准入。
RiskManagement：风险管理。
EndpointProtection：终端防护。
Overview：概览页。
ITManagement：IT管理。
InstanceManagement：实例管理
parameters.name: operation_func

parameters.help_en: The operation type. The value must be exactly the same as the original operation type recorded in the log. The OperationType in the returned result is localized based on the request language and may differ from this filter value
parameters.help_zh: 操作类型。取值需与日志中记录的原始操作类型完全一致；返回结果中的OperationType已按请求语言本地化，与该筛选值可能不同
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The operation status. Valid values:
success: The operation is successful. Equivalent values are true and Success.
failure: The operation fails. Equivalent values are fail, failed, false, and Failure.

If this parameter is not specified, only records of successful operations are returned
parameters.help_zh:
操作状态。取值：
success：成功，等价取值为true、成功。
failure：失败，等价取值为fail、failed、false、失败。

不传时仅返回操作成功的记录
parameters.name: operation_status

Logs.description_en: The list of administrator operation audit logs. The logs are sorted in descending order of operation time
Logs.description_zh: 管理员操作审计日志列表，按操作时间倒序排列

AfterAction.description_en: The snapshot after the operation. It is recorded as-is by the audit framework and is not localized. This field is empty for historical logs that are not connected to the audit framework
AfterAction.description_zh: 操作后快照，由审计框架原样记录，不做本地化处理。未接入审计框架的历史日志该字段为空

BeforeAction.description_en: The snapshot before the operation. It is recorded as-is by the audit framework and is not localized. This field is empty for historical logs that are not connected to the audit framework
BeforeAction.description_zh: 操作前快照，由审计框架原样记录，不做本地化处理。未接入审计框架的历史日志该字段为空

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the operation fails. This field is empty when the operation is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 操作失败时的错误码。操作成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the operation fails. This field is empty when the operation is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 操作失败时的错误信息。操作成功时为空
ErrorMessage.example: the specified resource is not found

OperationFunc.description_zh: 操作功能模块。返回值已按请求语言本地化

OperationPage.description_zh: 操作页面。返回值已按请求语言本地化

OperationType.description_zh: 操作类型。返回值已按请求语言本地化

TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的日志总数
